Cashless Process & Important Riders

How cashless hospital admissions work and how essential riders complete your health coverage.

1. How Cashless Authorization Works

Under cashless hospitalization, the insurance company pays eligible medical bills directly to the network hospital.

  1. Planned Admission: Submit the pre-authorization form at the hospital's TPA desk 48-72 hours in advance.
  2. Emergency Admission: Notify the insurer/TPA desk within 24 hours of hospital admission.
  3. Pre-Auth Approval: The insurer sends an initial approval letter, settling the final bill directly upon discharge.

2. Key Health Insurance Riders

  • Consumables Cover: Covers non-medical items (gloves, PPE kits, masks, syringes) that standard policies exclude and often make up 10-15% of the total hospital bill.
  • Hospital Daily Cash: Provides a fixed daily allowance to cover incidental non-medical expenses incurred by family members during hospitalization.
  • Zone Upgrade Rider: Eliminates co-payment penalties if you seek treatment in Tier-1/Metro hospital zones.
